description: Welfare schemes and pensions for senior citizens in Karnataka

schemes.name: Sandhya Suraksha Yojana
schemes.summary: Monthly pension of Rs 1,000 for senior citizens aged 65 and above in Karnataka.

requirements.criterion: Must be 65 years of age or older.
requirements.evidence: Applicant must have attained 65 years of age.

requirements.criterion: Combined family annual income must not exceed Rs 20,000.
requirements.evidence: Total annual income of applicant and spouse should not exceed Rs 20,000.

documents.name: Age Proof Certificate
documents.evidence: Age proof from authorized medical officer or school marks card

documents.name: Bank Passbook
documents.evidence: Bank account copy for monthly pension credit
